summary: Local clipboard history opens promptly, with clearer control over iCloud and release notes that match your update.
changes: Open and search your saved clipboard history while iCloud is unavailable. Sync status explains account or connection problems and lets you retry.
Choose Enable iCloud Sync in Settings to share your clipboard history. Enabling sync uploads your local history to your private iCloud account; local-only use remains available.
What’s New opens after an update, including a new build of the same version, and remembers your dismissal. You can reopen it in Settings and browse earlier releases offline.
